carrying_the_disclosures_to_where_the_te.the_layer: data/corpus_caveat_layer/ resolves every disclosure to the records it governs. 19,420 of 25,454 records carry a caveat; 7,551 carry a MATERIAL one. scripts/search_corpus_unified.py joins it onto every result, so the caveat now travels with the text.
carrying_the_disclosures_to_where_the_te.two_classes_because_they_are_not_equal: Presenting 2,778 notes as equals is as unhelpful as presenting none. MATERIAL changes how the text should be used or cited — visual_reading, encoding_damage, duplicate_text, source_defect_preserved, not_an_article, numbering_gap, currency_risk, treaty, article_specific. PROVENANCE says how the text was obtained — single_source, no_decision_number, secondary_source_unreachable, no_structural_headings, normalisation, title_resembles_another_track, companion_not_ingested, date_not_pinpointed. Anything matching neither is carried through as `other` WITH its key, so nothing is dropped for failing to fit a category.
attribution_was_the_hard_part_and_it_too: Attaching every track-level disclosure to every record of the track marked 3,682 records «read by eye» when 213 were. Telling a reader that a machine-verified record rests on one person's eyes is a false statement about verification — worse than saying nothing. visual_reading and not_an_article are now resolved PER RECORD: the first from the record keys a track validator declares, the second from the record's own stored label.

Keying the artifact map by (track, article number) collapsed components: a corpus holding both a law and its implementing regulation has an article 28 in each, so a law-only adjudication marked the regulation's article too. Keyed by (source dir, component, number) instead.

Accepting an article_path's last segment as a key when it merely contained «_art_» rejected «..._appendix_001» — a real key — and fell back to a numeric lookup that resolved appendix 1 to ARTICLE 1, attaching one record's caveats to a different record. The segment is now accepted only when it IS a key of some artifact.
carrying_the_disclosures_to_where_the_te.verified: The validator checks attribution first: 0 records marked visual_reading that no validator declares, 0 marked not_an_article whose own label is an article's. 208 marked against 213 declared and 1,476 against 1,568 — under-attributing, which is the safe direction: the layer never tells a reader something false about how a record was verified.
carrying_the_disclosures_to_where_the_te.what_it_looks_like_in_use: A search for «تعريف غسل الأموال» now returns the AML provisions WITH «صدر تعديل منشور بعد الطبعة المحفوظة، ولم يثبت أن النصّ المخزَّن يستوعبه». A search for «جدول المقابل المالي» returns the fee schedule WITH «وحدات هذا المسار ليست كلها مواد — فلا تُستشهد بوصفها مواد».

asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.the_gap: The corpus was built almost entirely from the Umm Al-Qura gazette archive, which is the right source and has one structural limit no amount of further crawling removes: the gazette publishes an instrument on the day it issues and never comes back to say it is still in force. Read the archive alone and you see what was issued, not what is current. The issuing authority is what knows — the CMA publishes a register of its regulations in force, and SAMA prints «الحالة: نافذ» on the face of every instrument in its rulebook.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.what_was_probed: Seventeen official registers were requested directly over HTTPS on 2026-08-06. Nine answered: CMA, SAMA's rulebook, ZATCA, MOMAH, MOH, NCA, CITC, HRSD and MCIT. Eight did not: the Bureau of Experts portal (laws.boe.gov.sa), the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Commerce, the National Center for Archives, the Istitlaa consultation platform, my.gov.sa, REGA and SPA.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.two_constraints_stated_plainly: SAMA's rulebook is an excellent source and closed to crawlers: clean server-rendered Arabic, instrument number, both dates, and an explicit in-force marker — exactly what «الساري فقط» needs — but its robots.txt is «User-agent: * / Disallow: /». No crawler was built against it; a limited manual read of the top of its tree is all that was taken. That is a commitment honoured, not an obstacle hit. Separately, the Bureau of Experts portal — the reference register for Saudi law as a whole — does not answer from this environment, and that is the widest blind spot in the sweep: it does not say coverage is complete from that side, it says the sweep could not ask.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.what_the_match_found: SAMA's statutory layer is held in full — 20 of 20. The one entry in its list the corpus does not hold is «نظام النقد العربي السعودي», the law superseded by the Central Bank Law in 1442H, so its absence is correct rather than missing. The CMA register is where the gap is: 37 instruments in force, 20 held, 17 not. The gap in this corpus is therefore not in the laws but in a regulator's own regulations.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.the_one_that_was_recoverable: «قواعد طرح الأوراق المالية والالتزامات المستمرة» — the largest of the seventeen — was in the gazette archive the whole time, refused at G10 for one reason: its annex block (thirty annexes, thirty-eight headings, 268,802 chars) carries no «المادة» heading, so the segmenter had nothing to end article 112 on and the whole block was absorbed into it. The text was on the page and correct; only its boundary was missing. Built this round as 150 records — 112 articles and 38 appendices — TIER_1, straight from the gazette.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.how_the_boundary_was_read: Not by knowing where annexes usually sit. The annex mark is also the commonest cross-reference in the same document — thirty-eight headings against some seventy references — and punctuation does not separate them: «الملحق 1:» heads a block in the CMA rules while «الملحق (9)» cites one, and the organic-farming guide inverts it. What separates them is the sentence around the mark, the same lesson the chapter stripper had to learn: a citation is either introduced by a preposition, or closed by a back-reference to the instrument itself («من هذه القواعد»), or followed by a conjunction naming a second annex. Both tests are needed — «يحدد الملحق (14) من هذه القواعد» opens on a verb, and «كما ورد في ملحق (4).» closes on a full stop. Four structural conditions then hold the split to cases needing no judgement: last record only, a complete gap-free 1..N run, at least three annexes, and a host article that survives the cut sentence-final.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.what_the_re_gate_showed: All seven pages G10 had refused were re-judged. One passed. «اللائحة الفنية لمعدات الضغط» has a single annex, below the floor. The organic-farming guide's own printing jumps from «ملحق رقم (4)» to «ملحق رقم (6)» — the run is incomplete, so nothing is cut; the gap is in the source and a partial cut is worse than none. Two are earlier editions of the instrument just built, and two are already held.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.why_the_other_sixteen_were_recorded_and_: Two have a gazette page that is a stub — title, date, and «تتمة اللائحة مرفقة نسخة PDF». One, the CMA glossary, has clean full text (62,887 chars) but is a list of defined terms, not articles or numbered clauses, so none of the three drafting forms reads it; it needs a fourth form learned from evidence, not an assumption that it is articles. Thirteen have no official HTML page at all.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.the_pdf_reader_was_built_measured_and_de: The CMA publishes all 37 as PDFs whose fonts store Arabic through broken character maps — «المادة» extracts as «املادة», «العشرين» as «العشرني». A reader was written that undoes this from the page's own geometry (a zero-width character belongs to the following glyph's ligature; runs sharing a baseline are one visual line, read right to left). It was then measured against four regulations the corpus ALREADY holds from the gazette: median coverage 1.00, 1.00, 0.99 and 0.95. The 1.00s prove the reader right and, incidentally, hand «لائحة سلوكيات السوق المالية» the second official publication its own disclosure said could not be found. The 0.95 is not a legal difference: that file renders «نطاق التطبيق» as «نااق التابيق». So the honest conclusion is that this reader is good for corroboration and discovery and not good enough to be a primary text source — the distance between 0.99 and 1.00 in legal text is not tolerable noise.
asking_the_issuing_authorities_what_is_i.what_remains_open: The Bureau of Experts portal unreachable from here; SAMA's circulars and sector instructions readable but disallowed by robots.txt; thirteen in-force CMA instruments with no official HTML rendering; the glossary awaiting a fourth drafting form; and five JavaScript-loaded authority registers (ZATCA, MOH, NCA, MOMAH, HRSD) each needing its own API read.

measuring_whether_the_authorities_pdfs_c.the_question: The previous round recorded sixteen in-force CMA instruments as unbuildable because their PDFs extract damaged Arabic. That was a judgement about four files. The corpus's whole remaining growth question rests on it, so it was measured instead: forty official PDFs from three authorities (CMA 29, MOMAH 10, HRSD 1), one verdict per file, by scripts/probe_official_pdf.py.
measuring_whether_the_authorities_pdfs_c.the_answer: BROKEN_CMAP 28, UNDECIDED 7, BROKEN_ORDER 2, IMAGE_SCAN 2, READABLE 1. One in forty is quotable verbatim, and it is a municipal building-requirements document rather than a law. The remaining coverage gap is not a shortfall of effort; it is a wall in the shape of the source. The gazette's clean server-rendered HTML is not a convenience — it is the only channel that meets this corpus's fidelity standard, and its archive is exhausted.
measuring_whether_the_authorities_pdfs_c.three_defects_kept_apart: LAM-MEEM: «المادة» arrives as «املادة». LAM-ALEF: «لائحة» arrives as «الئحة». ORDER: both ligatures sound but the justified line's runs interleave, so every character is right and the sentence is not. A file can carry any combination, and a probe that measures one and reports readability is wrong.
measuring_whether_the_authorities_pdfs_c.three_measurement_mistakes: Each would have produced a confident wrong answer, and each was caught by reading the extracted text rather than trusting a ratio. (1) The first check looked for «املادة» and pronounced six municipal files clean; they simply do not use the word «المادة» — they are drafted in «متطلبات», and their damage reads «املتطلبات». (2) The second stopped at the ligature maps. «لائحة الإبلاغ عن مخالفات نظام السوق المالية» is a regulation this corpus ALREADY holds verbatim from the gazette, so it can score a reading instead of arguing about one: its maps are sound, and its plain text layer still reproduces the corpus's own articles at median 0.62, position-sorted at 0.75, geometry-aware at 0.99. Sound maps are not readability. (3) The third added the order test and still passed two files reading «الئحة» for «لائحة» — the lam-alef ligature was transposed, and the lam-meem test cannot see it because both readings open on «ا».
measuring_whether_the_authorities_pdfs_c.a_test_that_cannot_decide_is_not_a_pass: The probe used to skip the lam-alef test when a file had too few of either form, which silently passed the file. «تعليمات تصريح تجربة التقنية المالية» has nineteen lam-alef tokens — one below the floor — and twelve of them are transposed. Inability to judge now returns UNDECIDED, never READABLE.

carrying_the_unit_label_into_the_rag_lay.the_gap: The search display was fixed last round to stop rendering «مادة N» from a positional integer. The chunking layer — the layer a retrieval application actually embeds — still carried `article_number` and no unit label at all, so the same false citation was one join away from every RAG consumer.
carrying_the_unit_label_into_the_rag_lay.the_measurement: 2,096 of the index's 25,604 records carry a unit label that is not an article's: «البند» 512, «القاعدة» 47, «الملحق» 43, ordinal bands «ثالثاً:», tables «جدول المقابل المالي». That is 8.2% of the corpus that a reader deriving citations from the integer would misname.
carrying_the_unit_label_into_the_rag_lay.the_fix: The chunking layer now carries `unit_label_ar` and `is_appendix`, and its own field note says `article_number` is positional. The export layer was checked and is already safe — its non-article records carry a null article_number, and both retrieval packs guard on that.

a_fourth_drafting_form_the_pipeline_was_.the_census: 122 pages were still refused at G3 — no «المادة» run, no ordinal-band run, no numbered-clause run. G3 was right that the pipeline cannot read them and said nothing about why, so 'teach a fourth form' would have been a guess about WHICH form. All 122 were fetched and classified by the structure they actually have. The first classifier said 30 of them were defined-terms lists; reading them showed it was matching any short phrase followed by a colon, which is ordinary legal prose. The same lesson as the PDF probe: a ratio only answers the question it was built to ask.
a_fourth_drafting_form_the_pipeline_was_.what_the_form_actually_is: Not a glossary. The UNTERMINATED heading: «المادة الأولى الأشخاص الذين تشملهم الاتفاقية تطبق هذه الاتفاقية على...» — number, then the article's own title, then its text, with no colon and no dash anywhere. Every heading pattern in this pipeline requires a terminator, and that requirement is not an oversight: it is what keeps «المادة السابعة من نظام المنافسة» a citation instead of shattering the document at every cross-reference. Its cost is a whole family — the international agreements, of which the corpus already holds some forty.
a_fourth_drafting_form_the_pipeline_was_.three_conditions_each_measured: The ordinal is drawn from a NAMED vocabulary rather than captured as free text, so a candidate is either a real ordinal or not a candidate. A candidate introduced by a preposition or citation word is dropped — «ضوابط استثناء الجهات الحكومية من تطبيق المادة السابعة» yields [7, 7, 11, 7, 11] before that test and nothing after it. And the surviving run must be complete and gap-free from 1 and at least six long: «قائمة المصطلحات» produces a single stray [5] and is refused, «السياسة الوطنية لمنع عمل الأطفال» produces [2, 10] and is refused.
a_fourth_drafting_form_the_pipeline_was_.a_spelling_variant_that_would_have_hidde: «اتفاقية للتعاون بين حكومة المملكة وحكومة جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية» prints «المادة الأولي» with a dotted ya. Without tolerating that variant its article 1 is missed, the run starts at 2, and the completeness rule refuses — correctly on the evidence it had — a document that is in fact whole.
a_fourth_drafting_form_the_pipeline_was_.what_it_recovered_and_what_it_did_not: Four pages yield a complete run; one passes every other gate and is built: «اتفاقية بين حكومة المملكة والصندوق الدولي للتنمية الزراعية», 17 articles, TIER_1. The other three are refused at G2 because bilateral treaties of the same type run 64-89% identical by text — the Latvia double-taxation agreement against the Iraq one, two bilateral cooperation agreements against the Chad one. Those are different instruments between different parties, and the overlap is the boilerplate of the family rather than duplication. The refusal is recorded rather than overridden: separating a boilerplate family from a genuine duplicate needs a judgement, and G2's gray band exists precisely to hand judgements to a human instead of auto-building through them.
a_fourth_drafting_form_the_pipeline_was_.safety: The form is a last-resort fallback and was measured as one. Across all 122 refused pages it fires on exactly four, and on none of them does any of the other three forms read the document; across 25 already-accepted pages it fires on none. It cannot change a reading that already works.

asking_whether_the_corpus_can_follow_its.the_question_nobody_had_asked: The cross-reference graph names a target for every citation it extracts — a track and an article number. Nobody had ever checked whether the target EXISTS. A citation the corpus cannot follow is a first-class retrieval defect: a model told to check «المادة (٢١٧) من النظام» either lands on the provision or it does not, and the graph is what decides.
asking_whether_the_corpus_can_follow_its.two_failure_modes_and_the_dangerous_one: DANGLING: the target track has no such article — visible, a reader who follows the link gets nothing. MISTARGETED: the target resolves to a real article OF THE WRONG INSTRUMENT — invisible, a reader gets a confident, plausible, wrong provision. The second is the worse defect and it is the one the corpus had.
asking_whether_the_corpus_can_follow_its.what_was_wrong: «من النظام» inside a subordinate instrument names its PARENT LAW. The scope detector read it as a self-marker and pointed the reference back at the citing instrument. 1,334 references are of this shape. 224 of them dangled — «قواعد نظر دعاوى الإفلاس» (24 records) cited as having an article 217, «لائحة طرق الاعتراض على الأحكام» (62) an article 185, «لائحة تنظيم العمل النموذجية» (72) an article 80. And 1,110 more RESOLVED, to the regulation itself, silently.
asking_whether_the_corpus_can_follow_its.the_parent_is_read_not_guessed: Two facts, in order: the citing track's own `base_law_track` where its source artifact declares one; otherwise the sibling track carrying the same unified-index corpus key with the component «law» — the grouping that already pairs arbitration_law with arbitration_implementing_regulation. Where neither names a parent, the reference is emitted as `parent_law_unresolved` with a null target: a citation whose parent this corpus cannot name is not a citation to the citing instrument. Only the non-demonstrative form is retargeted — «من هذا النظام» says THIS one, and reading that inside a regulation would be a judgement rather than a fact.
asking_whether_the_corpus_can_follow_its.and_a_self_target_the_corpus_cannot_foll: Where no scope marker sits near a citation the generator defaults it to the citing instrument at medium confidence — the right default, and sometimes wrong. When it is wrong the corpus can say so with no judgement at all: a five-article instrument has no article 155. 72 references were asserting exactly that; they are now `intra_law_unresolved` with the citation kept and the destination dropped.
asking_whether_the_corpus_can_follow_its.measured_before_and_after: Followable targets went from 4,648 of 4,949 checkable (93.9%) to 4,566 of 4,570 (99.9%), and the 1,110 silent mis-targets are gone. Four dangling references remain and are published individually: a VAT-agreement citation the name matcher attached to the wrong instrument, two citations to article 29 of «نظام السياحة» where the corpus holds nineteen, and one to article 42 of «نظام الزراعة».

the_archive_index_had_an_end_date_and_th.the_gap: Every coverage claim this corpus has made rests on an archive index of 8,997 pages. That index has an END DATE — 2026-07-31 — and the gazette does not stop publishing. Nothing had ever re-checked it, so 'the archive is exhausted' was true of a snapshot, not of the source.
the_archive_index_had_an_end_date_and_th.what_the_re_index_found: All 163 monthly sitemaps were re-fetched and diffed against the index. 45 addressable document pages are absent from it. 31 are older pages the index simply never listed, and ZERO of those pass the gates — the index was not missing instruments, it was missing non-instrument pages. 14 were published on 2026-08-07, the day this ran, and FOUR of them pass every gate.
the_archive_index_had_an_end_date_and_th.built: نظام إيرادات الدولة (30 articles) · اللائحة التنفيذية لنشاط نقل البضائع عبر الدراجة الآلية لأغراض تجارية (29) · القواعد الموحدة لملاك العقارات المشتركة بدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية (14) · آلية نقل أصول البورصة العقارية إلى الهيئة العامة للعقار (8). The other ten are approval decrees carrying no article text, bare royal decrees, and one regulation refused at G13 as a flattened table.
the_archive_index_had_an_end_date_and_th.a_new_law_that_is_not_yet_in_force: «نظام إيرادات الدولة» is the find that matters, and it is more delicate than it looks. Its article 29 says verbatim: «يحل النظام محل نظام إيرادات الدولة، الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م/68) وتاريخ 18/11/1431ه» — it replaces the law this corpus holds as track state_revenue_law. But its article 30 says: «ينشر النظام في الجريدة الرسمية، ويعمل به بعد (مائة وثمانين) يوما من تاريخ نشره». So the new law is PUBLISHED and NOT YET EFFECTIVE, and the 1431H law is the one in force today. Its legal_status_ar is «منشور ولم يبدأ العمل به بعد», not «ساري»; the old track is kept, not retired; and the track's own disclosure says citing the new provisions as effective today would be wrong. Supersession that has been enacted but not commenced is not supersession yet.
the_archive_index_had_an_end_date_and_th.an_exclusion_that_lives_in_the_decision_: Clause two of Council of Ministers Decision 129 exempts the National Development Fund and its subsidiary funds and banks from ten named articles of the new law. The exemption is in the DECISION, not in the law's text, so nothing was written onto those articles. It is disclosed on the track instead, so their text is not read as unqualified.
the_archive_index_had_an_end_date_and_th.the_lesson_for_the_coverage_claim: 'The archive is exhausted' is a statement with a timestamp on it. This corpus now knows that its own index is a snapshot, and that re-indexing costs one sitemap fetch. Four in-force instruments were sitting one diff away.

a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.the_gap: The supersession graph is hand-classified on purpose — its own policy says every edge was read against documented text, never inferred from a decree being older or from topical similarity. That policy is right and it has one consequence nobody had costed: a hand-written graph CANNOT NOTICE a supersession that arrives after it was written. It ages silently. It had aged: «نظام إيرادات الدولة» was ingested with an article 29 that replaces a law this corpus holds, and the graph gained no edge, because nothing was watching.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.what_the_audit_measures: scripts/audit_unrecorded_supersessions.py reads every record's own article text for the two clauses a Saudi instrument uses when it supersedes. NAMED («يحل هذا النظام محل نظام مكافحة الرشوة الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم 15») names the instrument replaced and is a relationship between two identifiable instruments. CONFLICT-ONLY («ويلغي كل ما يتعارض معه من أحكام») names nothing at all — 73 records carry it and NOT ONE is an edge candidate, because turning it into an edge would mean inventing the other end.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.the_verb_means_what_its_object_says: The first pass matched «يحل ... محل» and returned 198 records. Reading them showed most are a DIFFERENT SENSE of the same verb: «يعين من يحل محله» — a deputy standing in for an absent committee member. The discriminator is what FOLLOWS «محل»: an instrument noun, never a pronoun or a person. 198 → 70.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.found: 70 tracks state a named supersession. 42 were already edges. 28 were not.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.how_the_28_were_classified: BY TITLE AND DECREE TOGETHER, NEVER BY DECREE ALONE. The first attempt matched the bare «م/N» in each clause against every held track's decree field and produced nonsense — agricultural_development_fund_law→fisheries_law, aml_law→prison_detention, companies_law→waste_management_law — because Saudi decree numbers are reused across unrelated instruments after each numbering reset. Of the 29 predecessors named, exactly TWO are held by this corpus and both matched on title AND number AND date; the other 27 carry a null target with the instrument described, exactly as civil_service_law's edge has always done.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.a_repeal_can_be_dated_in_the_future: state_revenue_law_1448 article 29 fully replaces state_revenue_law — and its article 30 delays its own commencement by 180 days from publication. Recording that as `repeals_full` would retire a law that is in force TODAY. A fourth relation was introduced, `repeals_full_deferred`, carrying the verbatim commencement clause in `commencement_ar`, and the validator now fails any deferred edge that lacks it.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.one_case_refused_an_edge: pharmaceutical_herbal_establishments_regulation article 41 carries a supersession clause that is not its own — it is the LAW's, and that edge already exists. The track's own disclosure records that its text overlaps its parent law by 89%. Recorded under ambiguous_or_excluded_cases: an implementing regulation restating its law's repeal clause repeals nothing, and an edge would double-count one repeal as two.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.a_documented_open_item_closed: copyright_law's superseded_by edge had said the successor was 'NOT ingested here'. It is now: copyright_law_2026's own article 59 names «نظام حماية حقوق المؤلف، الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م/41) وتاريخ 1424/7/2ه» — this track by title, number and date together, with no reliance on the decree number of the successor. DISCLOSED: the successor's gazette page does not restate a decree number, so the 'M/169' label still comes from a registry note and secondary reporting. The RELATION is primary-sourced; the decree LABEL is not.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.result: 102 edges over 82 tracks → 132 edges over 109 tracks. The audit now reports 0 unrecorded.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.the_standing_check: scripts/check_gazette_index_freshness.py compares the gazette's DECLARED sitemaps against the archive index this corpus holds. Default cost: the monthly sitemaps modified at or after the index's own end date plus the two most recent — a handful of requests, not 163. robots.txt is honored as a commitment: only declared sitemaps are fetched. It separates two facts that are easy to conflate — INDEX_STALE_ONLY (the harvested index lags the corpus; no content missing) from NEW_LEGISLATIVE_PAGES (the corpus has never examined these). A network failure reports UNREACHABLE, never 'nothing was published'.
a_hand_written_graph_cannot_notice_what_.what_it_found_on_first_run: 15 legislative pages absent from the index; 4 of them already tracks (the index lags, the corpus does not); 11 never examined. Ten of the eleven are correctly refused by the gates — they are the ENACTING DECISIONS for instruments the corpus already holds (4001548 approves the motorcycle regulation, 4001555 the GCC rules, 4001567 the state revenue law). ONE is a real in-force regulation this corpus lacks: «لائحة المتطلبات الاقتصادية الفعلية للمناطق الاقتصادية الخاصة» (4001553), refused by G13 — and the refusal is right for the wrong reason: the page is BILINGUAL INTERLEAVED, Arabic and English alternating sentence by sentence, a FIFTH publication form the pipeline has never handled. Set aside, documented, not forced.

a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.the_gap: The gazette-freshness watcher found one real in-force regulation this corpus lacked — «لائحة المتطلبات الاقتصادية الفعلية للمناطق الاقتصادية الخاصة» (uqn 4001553) — refused by G13 as 58% reference codes. The refusal was right and the reason was not: the page is not prose at all. It is a TABLE, English in the left cells and Arabic in the right, row by row, with the item number repeated at both ends. Flattened by the tag stripper the two languages alternate sentence by sentence, and every density measure reads that as noise.
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.the_split_is_structural_not_statistical: The obvious fix — keep the runs whose characters are mostly Arabic — is a guess dressed as a measurement, and it fails on exactly the sentences that matter: the ones where an Arabic provision quotes a Latin term. The gazette already marks the split in its own markup, one <td> per language. Reading the Arabic COLUMN is reading the source. This is the first of the five publication forms that is not a numbering convention.
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.the_invariant_and_the_denominator_it_is_: Every Arabic character in the ARTICLE BLOCK must survive into the output, or the extraction refuses (G15) rather than storing a text with a hole in it. THE DENOMINATOR IS THE WHOLE POINT, AND THE FIRST VERSION GOT IT WRONG: measured against the table alone, the detector fired on «دليل الصحة الحيوانية» — an ALREADY-BUILT 83-record track whose page carries a bilingual DISEASE-NAME LIST, 83 rows of Arabic name against Latin name. Only 3,146 of that page's 31,144 Arabic characters are inside its tables; the guide's provisions are the prose around them. Substituting the reconstruction would have destroyed nine tenths of a built track WHILE REPORTING A PERFECT SCORE. A safety check measured against the wrong denominator is not a weak check, it is a false one. The fix: a bilingual table is a publication form only when the table IS the document (≥90% of the block's Arabic).
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.how_the_change_was_proved_safe: All 127 previously accepted pages and all 124 pages refused for having no recognisable structure were re-fetched and re-judged. Exactly ONE built page changed behaviour — 24606, the animal-health guide — which is how the wrong denominator was caught. After the fix it reads as before, and G2 reports 100% of its text already covered, which is the measurement that says nothing moved. NO refused page becomes acceptable: of the three bilingual tables among them, two are catalogues of standard numbers (correctly refused at G13) and one is refused at G15 because its Arabic column cannot be read without loss. An honest negative result: this form unlocked the archive by exactly one document.
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.a_defect_it_found_inside_the_corpus: Scanning every stored Arabic record for Latin letters found 353 records across 126 tracks carrying some Latin — almost all of it legitimate (species names, acronyms, standard codes). Exactly ONE track is interleaved: regional_headquarters_tax_rules, all 16 of whose records hold MORE Latin than Arabic. It was built from this same bilingual form, flattened. English paragraphs sat inside `text_ar`; the item letters «أ-» «ب-» had migrated to AFTER their paragraphs because the Arabic numbering cell trails the text in table order; and article 9 had swallowed the heading «الفصل الخامس: المخالفات والعقوبات».
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.the_repair_and_its_measurement: Re-read from the Arabic column: the Arabic characters in each of the 16 articles match the stored text CHARACTER FOR CHARACTER, except article 9 which loses exactly 29 — precisely the chapter heading, which returned to the chapter structure where it belongs. The track's chapter structure went from one invented «أحكام تمهيدية» band to the source's own six chapters. No legal text was lost; the English left and the order came right. Repair rather than disclosure, because no judgement was needed — the Arabic column is the source's own.
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.built: sez_economic_substance_regulation — 9 articles in 4 chapters, TIER_1, uqn 4001553.
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.repaired: regional_headquarters_tax_rules — 16 articles, 6 chapters, English removed from text_ar.
a_fifth_publication_form_the_bilingual_s.kept_distinct: Both instruments use the term «المتطلبات الاقتصادية الفعلية» and they are NOT the same rule: the new one binds licensed entities in the special economic zones, the repaired one binds multinationals' regional headquarters. Neither supersedes the other, and the disclosure on each says so, because a retrieval layer that conflates them would answer the wrong taxpayer.

the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.the_gap: Every coverage claim rests on one harvested artifact — a title-and-date index of the Umm Al-Qura archive, built once, ending 2026-07-31. The freshness watcher could say it was behind. Re-harvesting showed the problem was not the tail.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.what_the_full_sweep_found: All 163 monthly sitemaps swept: 479 addressable pages the index had NEVER seen, and they were not merely recent. They live under URL SUB-SECTIONS the original harvest never walked — /decisions-and-regulations/rules-and-regulations/, /authorities/, /the-royal-court/, /council-of-ministers-decisions/. The index was not out of date so much as the wrong SHAPE, and nothing in the repository could have said so, because the only thing ever compared against the gazette was the index itself.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.incremental_by_judgement_not_by_shortcut: Re-fetching all 8,997 pages would spend hours re-confirming titles that do not change and would discard a completed truncation-recovery pass. So an id already in the index is never re-fetched and never overwritten — and the one thing that cannot catch, a title the gazette has since edited, is written into the index's own refresh log.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.the_sitemaps_are_not_an_inventory: All 163 sitemaps together expose 638 pages against 9,442 in the index. This tool can EXTEND the index and can never rebuild it, so the number that means anything is how many pages it added, not how many it saw.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.two_measurement_fixes: 19 of the 163 sitemaps failed on connection reset — all old months — and a sweep silently covering 144 months reads exactly like one covering 163, so the fetch now retries transport errors while still never retrying an HTTP status, which is a real answer. And the first merge wrote six entries with BLANK DATES because the date search was capped at 200 KB while these pages run to ~800 KB with the masthead ~740 KB in. An entry with a blank date is worse than a missing one — it reads as harvested and answers nothing — so incomplete pages are reported and not merged, and 34 /infographic/ pages are skipped by section for the same reason.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.result: index 8,997 -> 9,442 pages, end date 2026-07-31 -> 2026-08-09; the watcher now reports FRESH. 61 newly-found legislative pages went through the gates: 53 refused with verbatim reasons, EIGHT accepted and built.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.the_find_that_justifies_the_round: «نظام التنفيذ» (uqn 4000869, 65 articles, published 2026-05-01) — a NEW ENFORCEMENT LAW. Its article 65 states verbatim that it replaces «نظام التنفيذ، الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م/53) وتاريخ 1433/8/13ه، وتعديلاته» — the enforcement_law this corpus holds — and that «يعمل بالنظام بعد مضي (مائة وثمانين) يوما من تاريخ نشره». So a REPLACEMENT OF A FOUNDATIONAL PROCEDURAL STATUTE was published, and this corpus did not hold it, because the index had never walked the URL section it sits in. It is recorded as published and NOT YET IN FORCE, the M/53 law is not retired, and the deferred-repeal edge added last round carries it. Article 64 gives the Minister 180 days to issue the new regulation, so the held enforcement_implementing_regulation remains the PREDECESSOR's regulation — disclosed on the track.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.the_other_seven: Two PDPL subordinate rule sets published the same day and proven distinct (sequence similarity 0.088); three constitutive statutes (Saudi Center for Competitiveness and Business, King Fahd National Library, Non-Oil Revenue Center); one set of property-ownership controls whose commencement is NOT self-dated but tied to another law's entry into force, recorded as ساري on the strength of this corpus's own foreign_ownership_law track rather than a guessed date; and rules for contracting with Saudis abroad whose wage table is stored verbatim with column alignment disclosed as lost to flattening.
the_archive_index_had_a_shape_it_never_c.a_bug_worth_recording: Wiring the eight tracks in, two validators were emptied to zero bytes: the patch opened each file for writing and read it in the SAME expression, so Python truncated before reading. Caught because both validators fell silent while still exiting 0 — a passing exit code from a file with nothing in it. Restored from git and redone as read-then-write.

measuring_the_blindness_instead_of_worry.the_question_the_last_round_opened: The archive index turned out to be blind to a URL SHAPE, which found 479 unseen pages. That answers one question and opens a bigger one: how would anyone know what else it is blind to? 'We re-harvested' is not an answer — the harvest sees only what the sitemaps expose, and all 163 sitemaps together expose 638 pages against 9,448 in the index.
measuring_the_blindness_instead_of_worry.the_method: The gazette addresses pages by NUMERIC ID, so the ids the corpus holds are a set with countable holes — and each hole can be PROBED. Two id spaces behave differently: the legacy space (8,018-28,849) answers at /details?p=<id> where a 404 is decisive, and the new space (4,000,207+) requires the page's EXACT sub-section, so a 404 across all seven observed shapes means only that the id opens under no shape this corpus has ever seen. That limit is printed with the result rather than left to be inferred.
measuring_the_blindness_instead_of_worry.what_it_measured: Legacy big holes: 0 of 40 sampled ids resolve — 11,871 missing ids are UNUSED ID RANGES, not unseen pages. The corpus is not missing twelve thousand legacy documents. New-space holes: 0 of 40 resolve across seven shapes. Legacy small holes: the sample found 3 of 40, so that one region was EXHAUSTED rather than extrapolated — all 123 probed, 6 resolved.
measuring_the_blindness_instead_of_worry.the_sample_overestimated_and_that_is_the: The sample put the small-hole rate at 8% (~10 pages); exhausting it gave 4.9% (6 pages). Extrapolating from 40 would have overstated the gap by two thirds. Sampling was right for deciding WHERE to look; it was not right for stating what is there.
measuring_the_blindness_instead_of_worry.the_six: Four congratulatory telegrams, one government-advertisements page, and one «اعتماد تحديث (128) مواصفة قياسية سعودية» from the standards-table family already refused. All six were put through the gates and refused with verbatim reasons, and all six were merged into the archive index — pages NO sitemap would ever have exposed.
measuring_the_blindness_instead_of_worry.result: THE ID SPACE HIDES NO INSTRUMENT. The holes are structural, not blindness. A negative result that cost about two hundred requests and closed an entire channel of doubt that could otherwise have absorbed days of guessing. A second discovery channel stays open: probing by id reaches what the sitemaps do not list.

a_regulation_names_its_own_parent_law.the_gap: 415 citations across 75 tracks read «من النظام» inside a subordinate instrument and pointed at nothing. The parent map had two evidence tiers — a declared base_law_track, or the law component filed under the same corpus key — and those tracks have neither.
a_regulation_names_its_own_parent_law.the_evidence_was_in_the_text: An implementing regulation opens by defining its terms, and the first of them is almost always «النظام: نظام كذا». 41 of the 75 say it outright. So the third tier reads the regulation's own definition and matches that NAME against the titles of the law tracks this corpus holds — reading the source, not inferring from topic. The regulation names its own parent.
a_regulation_names_its_own_parent_law.title_collisions_are_the_trap_not_a_deta: Exactly two law titles are held twice — «نظام التنفيذ» and «نظام إيرادات الدولة» — and in both cases the pair is a law and its PUBLISHED-BUT-NOT-YET-IN-FORCE replacement, a shape this corpus only acquired when it began ingesting deferred repeals two rounds ago. A dictionary keyed by title silently keeps whichever it saw last, and the first run duly pointed enforcement_providers_regulation at enforcement_law_1447: a regulation resolved to a law that will not be in force for months. The fix is not a preference for older tracks — it is to ASK THE SUPERSESSION GRAPH, whose repeals_full_deferred edge names in classified data which of the pair is still in force. Anything still ambiguous stays unresolved, because a citation with no target is a visible gap and a citation with the wrong target is a confident wrong answer.
a_regulation_names_its_own_parent_law.a_statute_can_be_its_own_nizam: Seven constitutive statutes define «النظام» as themselves — one by its full title, six by the shorthand «النظام الأساس للمستشفى / للجامعة / للمؤسسة». The first produced a track listed as its OWN PARENT, which is how the earlier 1,110-reference mistargeting looked from the outside; the other six were reported as 'names a law this corpus does not hold', which reads as a coverage gap and is nothing of the kind. Both now route to intra_law.
a_regulation_names_its_own_parent_law.result: 415 -> 236 unresolved: 179 citations gained a target and 13 more became intra_law. Followable targets stay at 99.9% (4,802 of 4,806).
a_regulation_names_its_own_parent_law.what_the_change_surfaced: Two of the graph's four dangling references are explained now: hospitality_mgmt and tourism_travel_services cite «المادة التاسعة والعشرين من النظام» while the tourism_law this corpus holds has 19 articles — their «النظام» is the REPEALED PREDECESSOR the corpus does not hold. The dangle is the lucky case; a citation to an article number that does exist in the current law would resolve silently to the wrong provision. A date-based check (regulation older than its parent) was written, MEASURED, and abandoned: only 10 of 1,255 parent references carry a gazette date on both ends, so it would have been shaped by which tracks record a date rather than by which are mistargeted. Recorded as a known limitation instead of papered over with a heuristic.
a_regulation_names_its_own_parent_law.a_coverage_signal_as_a_by_product: Eight tracks name a parent no held title matches. Some are genuinely absent from this corpus — «نظام البلديات والقرى», «نظام الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية», «نظام إجراءات التراخيص البلدية» — and some are too generic to match anything («نظام الهيئة»). The matcher also cannot see a parent published as a «تنظيم» rather than a «نظام».

the_corpus_says_in_its_own_text_what_it_.the_strongest_gap_evidence: Every other coverage audit here reasons from the outside in: ask a source what exists, compare. This one reasons from the inside out. A held regulation opens by defining «النظام: نظام كذا», and if no track carries that title the corpus is saying, in its own text, that it lacks the law it implements. Not a guess about what might be absent — a citation with nothing on the other end.
the_corpus_says_in_its_own_text_what_it_.found: FOUR distinct parent laws, named by five held tracks, none held and none reachable: «نظام تنفيذ اتفاقية حظر تطوير وإنتاج وتكديس الأسلحة البكتريولوجية» (5 stranded citations), «نظام البلديات والقرى» (named by two tracks), «نظام الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية», and «نظام إجراءات التراخيص البلدية». Two further names the parser reported are not law titles at all but sentences it mistook for one; they are NAMED in the report rather than filtered out, so the gap count stays honest and the parser's failure stays visible.
the_corpus_says_in_its_own_text_what_it_.one_was_a_false_gap_and_the_fix_generali: «نظام الهيئة» matched nothing — because it is not a title, it is the citing instrument's own shorthand. That same instrument defines «الهيئة: هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد» two lines earlier, and composing its own two definitions gives «نظام هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد», which this corpus HOLDS as nazaha_law. Reading two of the source's sentences instead of one is still reading the source. 236 -> 235 unresolved.
the_corpus_says_in_its_own_text_what_it_.why_the_rest_cannot_be_reached_measured_: THE GAZETTE'S ADDRESSABLE ARCHIVE EFFECTIVELY BEGINS IN 2021. Of the 9,448 pages this corpus has indexed, 457 — 4.8% — predate it: about fifty a year across nine years, against roughly nineteen hundred a year after. Older issues are published as whole-issue PDFs, not per-document pages, so a pre-2021 instrument is generally NOT obtainable through this channel however thoroughly it is swept — and it has now been swept three ways: sitemaps, URL sub-sections, and id-space probing.
the_corpus_says_in_its_own_text_what_it_.what_that_bounds: Every coverage claim in this repository. «The gazette archive is exhausted» has always meant, and can only ever mean, EXHAUSTED FROM 2021 ONWARD. Anything older needs a different official source, and the ones tried are documented: laws.boe.gov.sa unreachable from this sandbox, ministry portals partially reachable. A gap whose cause is measured can be argued with; one that is merely noticed cannot.
